import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
  {"name": "S2", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
  {"name": "E", "kind": "enum", "values": ["a", "b"]},
  {"name": "A0", "kind": "array", "element": "U8", "size": 0},
  {"name": "P0", "kind": "struct", "fields": []},
]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S2"], ["z", "A0"], ["p", "P0"], ["e", "E"]],
            "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]
# s: x0 buffer, x1 x2 chars; z: x3 (array, no slot); p: x4 (struct, no slot); e: x5; result r: x6
base = [obj("x1", ord('a'), 1), obj("x2", ord('b'), 1), obj("x5", 0, 4), obj("x6", 0, 1)]
# empty array/struct reserve ids but no objects
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"],
       "machine": None, "runs": []}
def R(objs, order=None):
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)}

doc["runs"] = [R(base)]
got = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(got["plans"][0]["slots"]), got["plans"][0]["variables"])
assert got["plans"][0]["variables"] == 7
assert got["plans"][0]["slots"] == [["x1",["s",0],1],["x2",["s",1],1],["x5",["e"],4],["x6",["r"],1]]

# run0: s="ab", result 0.  run1: same recovered s, different result -> DUPLICATE
doc["runs"] = [R(base), R([obj("x1", ord('a'), 1), obj("x2", ord('b'), 1), obj("x5", 0, 4), obj("x6", 1, 1)])]
got = run(doc)
assert [r["status"] for r in got["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE"], got["records"]
assert got["records"][1]["model_result"] == 1
assert got["corpus"][0]["witnesses"] == [0, 1]

# run with NUL then junk: recovered "a" -> same identity as run with just "a" + 0 pad
r_a = [obj("x1", ord('a'), 1), obj("x2", 0, 1), obj("x5", 0, 4), obj("x6", 0, 1)]
r_a2 = [obj("x1", ord('a'), 1), obj("x2", 99, 1), obj("x5", 0, 4), obj("x6", 5, 1)]
doc["runs"] = [R(r_a), R(r_a2)]
got = run(doc)
assert [r["status"] for r in got["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE"], got["records"]
assert got["corpus"][0]["inputs"]["s"] == "a"
print("PASS identity ignores post-NUL bytes and model result")

# object order is irrelevant
doc["runs"] = [R(r_a), R(list(reversed(r_a)))]
got = run(doc)
assert [r["status"] for r in got["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE"], got["records"]
print("PASS object order irrelevant")

# empty array vs empty struct: distinct param names so also distinct inputs
modules2 = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "S2"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]
doc2 = {"types": types, "modules": modules2, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
got2 = run(doc2)
print(json.dumps(got2["plans"][0]["slots"]))
PYEOF
